About.title: Fire safety since 1983
About.lead: Tüpaş has worked in fire and safety in Istanbul since 1983. Since 1989 we have manufactured fire extinguishers in our own facility in Yenibosna.

founded.title: Founded
founded.text: Tüpaş started out supplying fire and safety equipment.

production.title: Our own production
production.text: We began manufacturing fire extinguishers at our facility in Doğu Sanayi Sitesi.

today.title: Today
today.text: We serve all of Istanbul with manufacturing, refilling and servicing, system installation and safety equipment.

About.facilityText: At our facility in Doğu Sanayi Sitesi, Yenibosna, we manufacture TSE-certified dry powder, CO2, foam and water fire extinguishers. Refilling and servicing are carried out at the same site.
About.qualityLead: Every extinguisher we make passes three core tests before it ships:

pressure.title: Pressure test
pressure.text: Checks that the body withstands pressures above its working pressure.

fatigue.title: Fatigue test
fatigue.text: Tests how the material holds up under repeated pressure cycles.

collapse.title: Collapse test
collapse.text: Checks that the body keeps its shape under external loads.

honest.title: Recommending the right product
honest.text: We recommend what genuinely suits your premises, not more than you need.

reachable.title: Staying reachable
reachable.text: We're still a phone call away after the sale, and we keep track of servicing and refills for you.

standards.title: Commitment to standards
standards.text: Our production follows the relevant standards and certification requirements.

Certificates.title: Certificates and approvals
Certificates.lead: Certification for the fire extinguishers we manufacture and for our quality management system. We are happy to share copies of current certificates on request.

items.tse: Issued by the Turkish Standards Institution (TSE), confirming our portable fire extinguishers conform to TS 862 EN3.
items.ce: Marking that shows products meet the essential safety requirements of EU legislation.
items.iso9001: Shows our production and service processes are run to the international quality management standard.
